decision: CSS Modules are the only styling mechanism in this project; Tailwind, PostCSS configuration, and any utility-class framework are permanently excluded.
key_insight: CSS Modules are the only styling mechanism in this project; Tailwind, PostCSS configuration, and any utility-class framework are permanently excluded.
rejected_reason: Tailwind requires PostCSS config and adds a build-time dependency that conflicts with the local-first, minimal-setup principle
CSS Modules are built into Next.js with zero config
